title: Building Resilience: Advanced Master Course
description: A 90-minute advanced course in emotional coaching, optional pattern tracking, practical problem-solving, and safe relationship repair with children.
outcomes: Respond to setbacks with safety, connection, and developmentally appropriate support.
Use optional, privacy-conscious tracking to notice context and helpful supports without diagnosing or monitoring a child.
Support child-led problem-solving and take adult responsibility for relationship repair.
Recognize when distress or safety concerns require professional or specialist support.
